_readme: Locality names only, imported from Moratorium Nation (CC-BY-4.0) by scripts/import_moratorium_nation.py. Consumed by src/story_tracker.build_gazetteer() to recognise place names in headlines. A name here asserts nothing about what the locality did — it is not a moratorium record and must never be rendered as one. Regenerate, don't hand-edit.
